paragraphs: In the Jerusalem Talmud, Bava Batra, at the beginning of chapter 2, he reported in the name of R' Yehoshua ben Levi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: רפ״ב gives beginning of chapter 2, not end. ריב״ל is completed as Yehoshua ben Levi, not Reish Lakish; its personal-title component remains R'. No named edition is independently checked.
The heading has no personal title. Biri conventionally vocalizes ביריי, and Levi is the understood subject of the reporting formula.
